title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.05450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As agents become more capable, they are moving beyond one-off tasks toward sustained assistance across successive user goals. Such assistance requires agents to discover how unfamiliar environments work, reuse what they learn across tasks, and keep that experience current as environments evolve. Existing benchmarks increasingly study experience reuse and adaptation, but provide limited insight into which parts of accumulated experience agents revise, retain, or lose. To address this gap, we introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark for the experience lifecycle across 18 interactive environments. It distinguishes structural experience about how an environment is organized and accessed from rule experience about reusable principles and constraints that guide decisions across tasks. translated_title: 迈向稳健的长生命周期智能体：在动态演化环境中对经验生命周期进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着智能体能力的不断增强，它们正从一次性任务转向跨越用户连续目标的持续协助。这种协助要求智能体探究陌生环境的运作方式，在跨任务中复用所学内容，并在环境演化时保持经验的有效性。现有基准越来越多地研究经验复用与适应，但对于智能体会修订、保留或丢失积累经验的哪些部分，其提供的洞察有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 ReScopeBench，一个面向经验生命周期、涵盖 18 个交互式环境的基准。它将关于环境如何组织和访问的结构性经验，与指导跨任务决策的可复用原则和约束的规则性经验区分开来。为研究经验如何被获取、复用和修订，我们提出了一种经验优先的构建方法。该方法围绕共享经验构建任务流，并……
tldr: 提出 ReScopeBench 基准，在 18 个交互式环境中区分结构经验与规则经验，并通过经验优先的任务流构建方法，系统评估智能体在环境演化过程中获取、复用与修订经验的完整生命周期。
en_tdlr: We introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark spanning 18 interactive environments that separates structural experience from rule experience and uses an experience-first task-stream construction to systematically evaluate how agents acquire, reuse, and revise their experience as environments evolve.
